title: Type safety
summary: No casts, no non-null assertions, no any, no unsafe Rust.

requirements.text: TypeScript in `src/`, `tests/` and `scripts/` has no type assertions other than `as const`, and no non-null `!`.
TypeScript has no `any`, and in `src/` no value of type `any` flows anywhere.
Lint rules cannot be disabled by a comment, except `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps`.
Every Rust crate forbids unsafe code, except the app crate, which denies it with one audited exception: the Android JNI entry point for background sync.
